core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Brutalism with Cyberpunk NOC aesthetics.
Density is Clarity: High-density information design for expert users (SREs/DBAs).
Data as Art: Charts and metrics are the primary visual elements.
Retro-Futurism: Terminal-inspired details (scanlines, monospace) mixed with modern glassmorphism.
anti_patterns: No 'Card Salad': Don't just dump cards on a white background.
No 'Soft SaaS' Gradients: Avoid extensive purple/pink blurs. Stick to sharp, technical colors.
No Generic Fonts: Use Space Grotesk for Headings, JetBrains Mono for ALL data.
No Empty Space: In a NOC, black space is wasted space. Use bento grids.

grid_system.dashboard_overview: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

DBInstanceCard.description: High-density card summarizing a DB instance health.
DBInstanceCard.structure: Header (Name, Type, Status), Middle (Health Score Donut + Sparklines), Footer (Tags, Uptime)

visual_enhancers.glass_headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-white/5 sticky top-0 z-50
visual_enhancers.scanlines: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))] bg-[length:100%_4px,3px_100%] opacity-20

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION ORDER: Navigation Sidebar Clean-up -> Database Monitoring Overview (Fleet) -> Database Detail View.
2. SIDEBAR: Refactor the sidebar to strictly follow the 'navigation_structure' defined above. Remove duplicates.
3. OVERVIEW PAGE: Implement the Bento Grid layout. Use the 'DBInstanceCard' component for each database.
4. DETAIL PAGE: Create a layout with a sticky header showing instance summary. Use Tabs for: 'Performance', 'Queries & Locks', 'Custom Metrics', 'Settings & Agent'.
- Performance: 4x2 grid of time-series charts (CPU, Mem, IO, Network, Connections).
- Queries & Locks: Split view. Top: Table of slow queries. Bottom: Lock analysis timeline.
- Custom Metrics: Grid of user-defined charts.
- Settings & Agent: Form for settings + Status card for Agent (Health, Version, Logs).
6. AGENT HEALTH: Ensure every DB card and detail header shows a distinct 'Agent Status' indicator (Online/Offline/Syncing).
7. DATA MOCKING: Create a comprehensive mock data file 'mock_db_data.js' to power these views if APIs are missing.
8. CHARTS: Use Recharts. Style them to match the 'Obsidian' theme (dark tooltips, no grid lines, neon strokes).

universal_guidelines.motion: Use framer-motion for page transitions and list entry (staggerChildren).
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure all interactive elements have aria-labels. Use widely supported colors for status (R/G/B) but add text labels.
universal_guidelines.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'phosphor-icons' only if specific technical icons are missing.
